summary: Implemented the portalocker core under portalocker/: fcntl-based lock/unlock with contention and error mapping, Lock/RLock/TemporaryFileLock with timeout and retry semantics, BoundedSemaphore and NamedBoundedSemaphore slot locking, open_atomic and coalesce, plus RedisLock on pubsub with its keep-alive thread; I also restored missing trailing newlines in constants.py, exceptions.py and __about__.py so the combine step produces valid Python. The last full-suite run gave 40 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped (the redis module skips without a redis server; the same redis tests passed against fakeredis in a scratch run that I removed afterwards).
